verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a documented REST Data Access API. It has an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec on SwaggerHub and a developer-portal reference with per-operation pages plus Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting and Versioning pages. The spec says it covers errors, projects and organization data, so listing and querying errors is supported, but the evidence never shows updating errors, fetching raw events, or permission-scoped tokens. The probe 404s for OpenAPI files on docs.bugsnag.com do not contradict the SwaggerHub-hosted spec. missing for 10: explicit error-update endpoints, raw event retrieval endpoints, evidence of scoped/least-privilege tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage
